ref_file_title: RB89 - Verifiable Secret Sharing and Multiparty Protocols with Honest Majority
note: STOC 1989, pp. 73-85, DOI 10.1145/73007.73014; cryptobib STOC:RabBen89 (verified). Statistical security against a malicious adversary for t < n/2 given a broadcast channel — the result the migrated prose misattributes to BGW88. Filename matches the one proposed by batch red-33 for the same paper.

ref_file_title: RT19 - Oracle Separation of BQP and PH
note: cryptobib STOC:RazTal19 (STOC 2019, pp. 13-23, DOI 10.1145/3313276.3316315); ECCC TR18-107. Bibliographic data verified against cryptobib; the abstract itself could not be fetched (ECCC, ACM DL, Semantic Scholar blocked). Result: a distribution over {+-1}^{2N} distinguished from uniform by a one-query quantum algorithm with advantage Omega(1/log N) but not by quasi-polynomial-size constant-depth circuits, giving an oracle A with BQP^A not in PH^A.

ref_file_title: Rom90 - One-way functions are necessary and sufficient for secure signatures
note: STOC 1990, pp. 387-394; cryptobib STOC:Rompel90 (verified in vendor/cryptobib; DOI matches). The paper's main content is sufficiency (OWF ⇒ DS via UOWHFs); the necessity direction recorded by this edge is the easy one asserted by the title, and the literature cites this paper for the equivalence.
